core.title: Iron Art Square Cabinet Knob, Acorn IKEBP

text.description_html:
Acorn IKEBP, Iron Art Square Cabinet Knob

With a unique shape for something with such a decisive old world appearance, the Iron Art Square Cabinet Knob is perfect for anyone looking for an enlightened viewpoint of traditional cabinet hardware. This beautiful 1-1/4" squared cabinet door knob is great not only for the kitchen, but for the bathroom and every other room in the house. Imagine an antique china cabinet with these knobs, bringing a hand made rustic touch to the hardware to accent the antiquity and craftsmanship.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home. Every piece of Acorn's Iron Art Line is forged by hand using the traditional techniques of the anvil and hammer. Just so, each piece is a little different, a little work of art. The black iron finish mimics the look of naturally weathered metal. The finish is backed by a lifetime warranty.

Specifications of the Square Iron Art Cabinet Knob:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Length: 1-1/4" square
  • Projection: 1"
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
